# waroom_service (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Waroom service. Use this data source to check that a service exists and to reference it from other resources, such as `waroom_service_label`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "waroom_service" "example" {
  name = "my-service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service ID. This is an alias for `name`, which identifies a service in Waroom.
